newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rainfall seen in key Brazil soybean states - Somar.
newsitem.headline: Rainfall seen in key Brazil soybean states - Somar.

text.p: Brazil's key soybean growing regions will see a week of rain which should improve planting conditions in areas where sowing has already begun, said independent meteorologists Somar.
In Rio Grande do Sul, two cold fronts are expected, with the first one hitting on Dec 4 followed by another on Dec 6.
Meanwhile in Parana isolated showers were forecast until the night of Dec 6-7 when a new cold front will cause widespread rains in the soybean producing region.
In the south-east and centre-west regions heavy showers are forecast together with warm weather, with high humidity in the Amazon region.
November was characterised by below-average rainfall in the soybean producing region of Rio Grande do Sul. In Mato Grosso, rains were isolated and evenly spread over the month.
